# commit-msg-lint

> Validate commit messages against Conventional Commits 1.0.0 with ten rules, git comment and scissors handling, and conservative automatic fix suggestions for a commit-msg hook Python package `trysac-commit-msg-lint`, import name `commit_msg_lint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
